request: 덕테이프 포스터를 만들어줘. 문구는 “서로 다른 속도”만 넣어줘. 어떤 느낌으로 할지는 맡길게.
common_constraints: Print the supplied title exactly once, with intact readable Hangul and the original word spacing. Line breaks may occur between whole words. The directions are internal guidance and must not be printed.
No other copy, supporting text, labels, numbers, logos, series identifiers, style names or watermarks. Depicted clothing, objects and surfaces must be unbranded and free of incidental text.
Each assigned maker produces only its own independent, single flat opaque poster, portrait 2:3. No panels, contact sheets, poster mockups or borrowing another maker's generated image as a reference.

The substantial non-glyph relation must remain recognizable with the title hidden and at reduced viewing size. Tiny ornament, wallpaper, background texture, gradients and 3D lettering alone do not satisfy it.

Preserve the assigned relation and distinction while solving practical crop, proportion, palette, alignment and title placement independently. There is no shared title-object-footer layout or common allocation of image and copy area.

Downstream native-tool production must request the maximum resolution supported by the current tool and model while preserving 2:3; verify the actual returned dimensions and readable copy after generation.

directions.concept: Different human paces coexist in the same place and the same captured moment.
directions.substantive_non_glyph_visual: A shared pedestrian ground contains one person pausing with weight visibly settled on a foot while another passes in a sustained directional motion blur. Their recognizable bodies, foot contact and unequal movement occupy the main scene; the still figure and moving passage must both survive a small view. Use a single continuous exposure-like scene rather than a montage or decorative streaks.
directions.expression_system: Observational location photography with a fixed viewpoint, credible ground, consistent light and selective motion blur. The contrast comes from bodily state within one space, rather than a filter applied to everything. The title uses clear, restrained, medium-weight Hangul with normal proportions and a steady horizontal baseline.
directions.copy_visual_relationship: The title acts as the still point of observation within the shared ground plane, close enough to the paused figure and passing trajectory to bind them. It remains completely sharp while movement passes beside it. Let the scene determine an open reading surface and crop; avoid turning the title into a remote header or a small caption beneath the photograph.
directions.distinction: M1 is an inhabited, continuous place with lateral passage and a quiet stationary title. M5 isolates two material processes under gravity and makes the title's downward grouping participate in their unequal descent; it must not inherit M1's environmental scene or horizontal viewing baseline.

directions.concept: The same succession of moments produces different distances traveled.
directions.substantive_non_glyph_visual: Two large, equal-sized moving disk forms leave the same number of retained positions from a shared origin. One progression remains tightly overlapping near the origin; the other separates into widely spaced positions and travels far across the field. These two finite progressions are the dominant graphic bodies, with their origin and unequal reach visible; do not turn them into an all-over dot pattern, fine diagram or tiny speed icons.
directions.expression_system: Flat, sharply bounded graphic overprinting: overlapping solid shapes accumulate density in the slower progression while the faster progression opens clear intervals. Keep the position-retention rule consistent. Large, sturdy Hangul supplies a stable graphic mass, with open counters and whole-word grouping rather than distorted or repeated letters.
directions.copy_visual_relationship: The single title group establishes the shared starting edge from which the unequal progressions depart. Its width and alignment give the viewer a reference for the two very different reaches. The slow sequence gathers near this title mass while the fast sequence pulls toward a distant crop; the maker determines the actual orientation and line breaks within that relation.
directions.distinction: M2 compares independent translations through repeated positions in an open field, with type as an origin. M3 shows physically coupled angular motion around two centers and places type in relation to the mesh. Do not introduce wheels, tooth contact or radial balance into M2.

directions.concept: Two connected parts can work together while turning at different rates.
directions.substantive_non_glyph_visual: A large toothed wheel and a smaller toothed wheel visibly mesh at a credible contact. Broad swept sectors associated with each wheel show the smaller turning through a greater angle while the larger turns through a smaller angle in the same imagined interval. The unequal wheel bodies and their working contact carry the idea; the sectors support it and must not substitute for the mechanism. No measurements, arrows, numerical markings or extra annotations.
directions.expression_system: A constructed cut-paper graphic with decisive tooth silhouettes, coherent layered planes and restrained contact shadows. Radial weight and the shared mesh organize the entire field. Compact, firm Hangul acts as a stable counterweight, with unwarped syllables rather than circular lettering or dimensional type effects.
directions.copy_visual_relationship: The title sits as a single readable block in the shared wedge of space adjacent to the mesh, making the working connection and the words mutually legible. Its mass balances the unequal circular bodies; the maker resolves scale and placement without covering the teeth or separating the title into a header. The rotating sectors must stay clearly distinct from the letter strokes.
directions.distinction: M3 is organized by interlocking centers, opposite rotations and physical transmission. Its title is a counterweight near the connection. M2 is organized by a common origin and unequal linear reach, with a dominant launch-edge title; changing disk silhouettes into gears is not enough to achieve M3.

directions.concept: Growth proceeds unevenly even within a connected living system.
directions.substantive_non_glyph_visual: A substantial exposed root network visibly connects two shoots of the same plant species: one has extended a long stem and opened its leaves, while the other is a short emerging shoot with leaves still folded. Shared root structure and consistent leaf anatomy make the unequal developmental states a relation, rather than two unrelated botanical specimens. Roots, stems and foliage form the principal composition in one continuous scene.
directions.expression_system: An expressive ink or relief-cut drawing whose solid foliage, directional stem marks and branching root contours describe actual plant structure. Selective irregularity follows the growth direction instead of covering the whole poster with texture. Robust hand-drawn Hangul keeps a consistent stroke logic, intact syllables and generous internal spaces.
directions.copy_visual_relationship: The title forms a grounded word group at the branching or soil boundary, with the connected roots below and the unequal growth above shaping its enclosure. The short shoot leaves a different amount of breathing room from the tall one, so the title belongs to this uneven living structure. Keep stems separate from glyph strokes and leaves clear of the copy; the maker can resolve a whole-word wrap and optical alignment.
directions.distinction: Both reveal unequal rates within a connection, but M4 uses asynchronous development and an organic ground-to-growth relationship. Its title belongs to a rooted boundary and its image rises irregularly. M3 uses instantaneous transmitted rotation, radial centers and a title counterweight beside a mechanical mesh.

directions.concept: Under the same gravity, different materials take different time to arrive.
directions.substantive_non_glyph_visual: Two similar unlabeled vessels pour simultaneously: thin water has descended into a lively splash and a spread pool, while thick syrup is still drawing out a long connected neck with a much smaller arrival below. The vessels, continuous streams and receiving surface must be physically readable. The unequal descent and arrival are major forms, not little droplets decorating an otherwise typographic poster.
directions.expression_system: A tightly staged material study with credible gravity, consistent light and distinct surface responses for transparent water and viscous syrup. Use the stretching neck, splash geometry and pooling to describe the processes; avoid generic floating-product gloss. The title uses clean, measured Hangul in a substantial stacked word group, without stretching the glyphs to imitate liquid.
directions.copy_visual_relationship: The title's downward reading occupies the irregular interval between the two pours, relating the vessels to their unequal arrivals. Its whole-word grouping follows the descent while stable spacing provides a readable counter-rhythm. The maker determines the available span and crop so neither stream, splash nor highlight obscures a syllable; there is no separate footer or vessel label.
directions.distinction: M5 builds a controlled vertical field of material tension and accumulation, with type participating in descent. M1 observes lateral human passage in a shared environment and uses a quiet horizontal title as a still point. M5 must read through viscosity and arrival, rather than borrowed motion blur or two passing figures.
